card.name: Dosing frequency after a dose amount
card.fires_on: The frequency part (mostly the ID in BID) right after a dose in mg, in drug interaction study descriptions. Also fires on similar frequency words such as h.s. or once daily.

modes.label: BID after mg dose
modes.description: The ID piece of BID following a drug and its mg dose in an interaction study.
modes.example: Terfenadine: Six healthy volunteers received terfenadine 60 mg B<<ID>> for 15 days.
